scope_statement: Add an apply-level product workflow status-migration use case and CLI surface over the Atom 37 planner. The use case must atomically validate current workflow/index/source state, move the durable effort folder, write updated workflow_state/index/event artifacts, preserve stable effort_id and prior paths, fail closed for stale/unsafe/conflicting state, and avoid lane dispatch, model execution, .idiom runtime mutation, or broad TUI interaction behavior.

commands: idiom tool context_pack --input '{"task":"phase 6 next atom after status migration contract product workflow design doc closeout CLI TUI status folder migration","mode":"plan","limit":8}'

idiom tool context_query --input '{"query":"product workflow apply status migration atomically move effort folder update workflow_state events effort index CLI no dispatch no model execution","resolution":"symbol","limit":12}'
JSON/JSONL validation for durable workflow artifacts
privacy secret-pattern scan over durable effort artifacts

discovery_evidence: context_query:product workflow apply status migration atomically move effort folder update workflow_state events effort index CLI no dispatch no model execution
privacy_note: planning report stores only scope, model assignment, command names, bounded findings, and blocker state; it does not store raw prompts, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, generated briefs, TUI transcript bodies, or customer-identifying data
